skills.name: dod-qe-automation
skills.title: Test Automation Definition of Done
skills.description: Governed completion criteria for turning written test cases into an automation suite that runs against a deployed application. Use when judging whether a Quality Engineering Worker's output is done: what must be traceable to a test case, what must conform to the Gherkin standards, what data must exist to run it, and what must be reported afterwards.
skills.pattern: Test automation from written test cases

dod_criteria.title: Test Script to Test Case Traceability
dod_criteria.check: Every supplied test case has a working script that executed to a pass, fail or skipped verdict, and every script names the case it claims. Scored over the union of the cases supplied and the cases claimed, so a case with no script and a script with no case both count against it. This counts working scripts, not passing tests — an application defect must fail the application, not the Worker.
dod_criteria.evidence: The run's own results and the supplied case list, each case matched to the scenario tagged with its id.
dod_criteria.adjudicator: Counted from the run, not judged

dod_criteria.title: Gherkin Conformance to Standards
dod_criteria.check: Every generated feature file conforms to the Gherkin standards the framework declares: one scenario per supplied case, an assertion only after an action and no setup after it, no step defined twice inside a suite, and no credential written into a script. Each rule is decided by parsing the file rather than by reading it.
dod_criteria.evidence: The feature files the run wrote, parsed before the suite executed.
dod_criteria.adjudicator: Counted from the run, not judged

dod_criteria.title: Test Data Mapped to Test Scripts
dod_criteria.check: Every data value a script reaches for is bound to a named fixture the run holds, before the suite runs. A script reaching for a record or a credential nothing supplies is a gap in the test data, not a failure of the application under test.
dod_criteria.evidence: The binding between each script's required values and the fixtures available to the run, taken before execution started.
dod_criteria.adjudicator: Counted from the run, not judged

dod_criteria.title: Report Generation
dod_criteria.check: A test report was produced after execution, can be read, and reports pass, fail or skipped for every scenario that ran. A report that cannot be parsed is a failure, not an absence.
dod_criteria.evidence: The run's own results, parsed, with every executed scenario looked for in them.
dod_criteria.adjudicator: Counted from the run, not judged
